full_prompt_en: A square fantasy illustration shows two young travelers sitting on rough stone ground against a wall of irregular masonry. On the left, a fair-haired youth in a brown coat and tall worn boots leans forward, gloved hands resting near the knees. On the right, another traveler in a vivid rust-orange jacket, white shirt, goggles on the head, and utility belt sits upright with a calm direct gaze. Their clothing has practical buckles, straps, gloves, and weathered fabric, suggesting a journey without showing action. The stone wall fills the background with individually drawn blocks, cracks, and pale mortar. Warm cream paper, brown leather, faded teal trousers, charcoal shadow, and the orange jacket create a restrained but lively palette. Fine pencil and ink lines describe faces, seams, boots, and stone edges, while soft watercolor or gouache washes fill larger surfaces. Diffuse daylight leaves short shadows under the seated figures and keeps the wall readable. The composition is balanced by the two adjacent poses and their differing eye directions. The whole frame feels like a character illustration from a richly built adventure world, quiet and observational, with tactile linework and slight paper wear rather than glossy digital rendering.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形奇幻插画呈现两位年轻旅人坐在粗石地面上，背后是一堵由不规则石块砌成的墙。左侧浅发少年穿棕外套与磨旧高靴，身体前倾，戴手套的双手靠近膝盖。右侧另一位旅人穿鲜明锈橙外套、白衬衣，头上架着护目镜，腰间有工具带，坐姿挺直，目光平静直接。衣装有实用扣件、带子、手套和风化布料，暗示旅程却没有动作。石墙填满背景，每块石头、裂纹和浅色灰泥都分别画出。暖乳白纸色、棕皮革、褪色青绿裤装、炭影和橙外套形成克制却活泼的色谱。细铅笔与墨线描绘面孔、接缝、靴和石边，柔和水彩或不透明水彩薄染填充较大表面。漫射日光在坐姿人物下方留下短影，并使石墙清楚可读。两种相邻姿态和不同目光方向平衡构图。整幅画像一个构建细致的冒险世界中的人物插画，安静、观察性强，有触感线描和轻微纸面磨损，而非油亮数字渲染。
style_prompt_en: A hand-drawn fantasy illustration style pairs precise pencil-and-ink line with muted watercolor or gouache wash. Weathered stone, leather, cloth, and metal fittings each receive small material-specific marks. Warm cream paper, brown, faded teal, charcoal, and a concentrated rust-orange accent organize the palette. Diffuse daylight keeps shadows modest and lets intricate background masonry remain visible. Two or more grounded focal forms can be balanced through different posture and gaze, while detailed costumes imply a larger world. Slightly irregular contours, paper grain, and worn edges preserve an illustrated-book finish. The mood is adventurous but resting, rich in observed detail without dramatic spectacle.
style_prompt_zh: 手绘奇幻插画风格把准确铅笔墨线与低饱和水彩或不透明水彩薄染结合。风化石、皮革、布和金属扣件各有针对材质的小笔迹。暖乳白纸、棕、褪色深青、炭灰和一处集中的锈橙点缀组织配色。漫射日光使阴影适度，并让复杂背景石造仍可见。两个或更多稳坐的焦点形体可通过不同姿态和目光平衡，细致服装暗示更大的世界。略不规则轮廓、纸纹和磨旧边缘保留插画书完成感。气氛有冒险背景却处于休息时刻，观察细节丰富，没有戏剧奇观。
theme_en: Two young travelers rest against a weathered stone wall in an illustrated fantasy scene
theme_zh: 两位年轻旅人在风化石墙前休息，呈插画式奇幻场景
name: Akihiko Yoshida
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
